lines.text: Have you ever wondered why you can't drive from Alaska to Argentina?
The Pan-American Highway runs from Prudhoe Bay in Alaska to Ushuaia in Argentina: about 30,000 kilometres through 14 countries, the longest road in the world.
lines.say: The Pan-American Highway runs from Prudhoe Bay in Alaska to Ushuaia in Argentina. About thirty thousand kilometres through fourteen countries. The longest road in the world.
cap: runs from Prudhoe Bay in Alaska
the longest road in the world

lines.text: But between Panama and Colombia, it simply stops. For 106 kilometres, there is no road at all: the Darién Gap.
lines.say: But between Panama and Colombia, it simply stops. For one hundred and six kilometres, there is no road at all. The Darien Gap.
cap: there is no road at all

lines.text: The highway ends at Yaviza in Panama, and starts again at Turbo in Colombia.
lines.say: The highway ends at Yaveesa in Panama, and starts again at Turbo in Colombia.

lines.text: In between: mountains, rainforest, and the swamps of the Atrato River, 80 kilometres wide.
lines.say: In between: mountains, rainforest, and the swamps of the Atrato River, eighty kilometres wide.
cap: and the swamps of the Atrato River

lines.text: In 1960, an expedition tried to drive across anyway. It took 136 days: about 200 metres an hour.
lines.say: In nineteen sixty, an expedition tried to drive across anyway. It took one hundred and thirty-six days. About two hundred metres an hour.

lines.text: Work on the road began in 1971 and was halted three years later. A second attempt was abandoned in 1994.
lines.say: Work on the road began in nineteen seventy-one and was halted three years later. A second attempt was abandoned in nineteen ninety-four.
cap: Work on the road began in 1971

lines.text: Why? The jungle keeps foot-and-mouth disease out of North America. It is a national park. And the people who live there do not want a road.
cap: And the people who live there

lines.text: So to drive from Alaska to Argentina, you still have to put your car on a boat.
